conclusions.subject: contract
conclusions.text: The shared Contract is faithful and complete against the fixed sources. META_DATA.Source pins candidate/solution.py::Model.forward and Golden_reference.Source pins problem/reference.py::Model.forward at commit 4849028, with the EVIDENCE.md role separation confirmed. All 30 forward parameters plus the kv_cache members k/v are registered with dtypes, nullability, defaults and ranges matching the signature, the candidate's validation (out required, kv_layout == HND, seven python_none options, bf16/fp32/int32 dtype and stride checks) and the constructed call. Compute defines, in definition-before-use order: THD varlen geometry with the declared domain (batch 1-32, qlen 1-8192, kvlen 1-262144, sums 16384/1048576, per-request qlen<=kvlen, the seven head tuples, page_size {16,32,64,128}, page-table addressing); FP32 scores from exact BF16 values scaled by bmm1_scale; bottom-right causal plus left-window masking with -inf and a provably nonempty visible set; FP32 softmax with bmm2_scale applied to values; natural-log base_lse with log-domain sink adjustment and exp(base-total) rescale before bf16 rounding; base-2 lse_result = total_lse/ln(2) written whenever the lse buffer is provided regardless of return_lse; in-place writeback keeping tensor identity, (out,lse)/out return routing, and the side-effect boundary (only out/lse mutate, workspace scratch). Every relation was checked line-by-line against reference.py (GQA mapping, visible alignment, gather, masks, logaddexp sinks, bf16 cast on copy_, /math.log(2), return routing), so the reference matches Compute on the contract domain and no Gap is required. Both Tolerance entries keep the only declared criterion (atol=.01, rtol=.05, max_mismatch_fraction=0) in source-record form with the explicit no-default limitation.

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: All required source categories were read and anchored. Implementation: candidate fast/slow paths, dtype-stride-shape validation, param packing (has_lse/has_sinks presence flags independent of return_lse; bmm1_scale x LOG2E is an internal base-2 conversion only) and the .cu kernels grounding Execution (warp-level mma.sync, __shfl_xor reductions, extern __shared__ smem, tcgen05.alloc CTA-scope tmem); the 2-CTA cluster path is default-off (FMHA_TC2) and correctly outside the minimal registration. io: metadata benchmark contract (mutates [out,lse], full_logical_tensor_when_present, scratch workspace_buffer) and the domain declaration naming shape_range.json authoritative and shape_cases.json representative-only. input: construction asserts, HND paged views, spare-column page tables, scale derivations, the exact 30-parameter call dict and writable views. reference: the full golden path. acceptance: CERTIFIED_BEST.json is a performance certification declaring no tolerance, formula or relative_to for any named output, so comparisons is [] and the numeric criterion remains the metadata source record in Tolerance. scope: shape_range domain and invariants adopted verbatim, and all 10 shape_cases verified inside the declared domain.

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: root.yaml is understandable without history or directory: every scale (total_q, batch_count, head_count, kv_head_count, head_dim, page_size, page_count, page_table_width, workspace_bytes) is introduced through named shape axes and bound in request_geometry before use; symbols (qlen_b, kv_len_b, group, score, masked, row_max, row_sum, y) are registered at their defining steps with consistent round-bracket (r,h) parameter versus square-bracket axis notation; both nullable branches (sinks, lse, out_dtype) are defined in Compute; the kv_cache member binding is stated in meanings; and the in-place outputs use distinct names out_result/lse_result with the write-back relationship defined in meanings and Compute. Regarding the worker's framework candidate inplace-output-naming-doc-gap: NOT confirmed as reviewer. DOC1's naming rule already requires constant, scale, input, output and symbol names to be unique within one contract, so registering an in-place result under a name distinct from the input buffer follows from the existing rules read together; there is no rule gap or conflict, only a possible redundant clarification, so the candidate is not carried to Supervisor.

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: The Contract stays at the caller level: the reference's 32/2048 chunking and the candidate's tile/split/dispatch knob machinery visible in the fixed source do not appear in Compute; max_q_len/max_kv_len are kept as declared planning metadata with all lengths taken from cum_seq_lens_q and seq_lens; scale base conversion (LOG2E) stays an implementation detail below the natural-domain math. Execution holds only the minimal source-backed thread/warp/cta registration with the register/smem/tmem storage names in the owning unit summaries, and Feature/Device/Architecture/Stack/Wiki keep the starter placeholders untouched. DESIGN remains the starter draft. This approval covers P1 segments 1-3 only; it does not approve Design content or any root representative selection.

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: One coherent domain across sections: Input ranges match the shape_range cross-field invariants exactly; shape axes align with Compute indexing (k[pg, h//group, off, d] over [page, kv_head, page_row, d]); Tolerance keys equal the output names and cover both outputs; outputs map onto the acceptance-defined outputs out/lse with identity and nonwrite storage preserved; all 10 fixed cases (seven geometries, four page sizes, window/sink/noncausal/decode combinations, distribution profiles) lie inside the declared domain. The known behavior difference - the candidate rejects return_lse=True with lse=None while the reference would return (out, None) - is outside the constructed call domain because input.py couples lse presence to return_lse (return_lse = lse is not None); the Contract stays faithful to the reference and does not adopt the candidate restriction, and the worker recorded the difference honestly. The strict read-only check exits 0 on the current raw with no diagnostics, confirming structural consistency.

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: Only necessary content is retained: a one-sentence Describe without tile, architecture or branch terms; meanings identify object roles without restating visible fields; Compute keeps the result-changing conditions (mask bounds, nonempty visible set, FP32 arithmetic, bf16 rounding point, sink adjustment, base-2 conversion, side-effect boundary) while omitting proofs, source process and optimization rationale; the Tolerance entries carry only the declared acceptance facts plus the explicit limitation; no experiment logs, knob history, todos or historical approvals appear in the YAML.

issues.detail: The external acceptance comparator is undefined in the provided materials: the only declared numeric criterion is metadata.json benchmark_contract.correctness_tolerances.default (atol 0.01, rtol 0.05, max_mismatch_fraction 0.0) for the defined outputs out/lse, and the designated acceptance file CERTIFIED_BEST.json is a performance certification carrying no tolerance, comparator formula, relative basis, normalization or non-finite handling. Both Tolerance entries therefore keep the declared thresholds in the prescribed source-record form with the explicit no-default limitation, so the gap limits only the external numeric acceptance boundary; task math, IO, side effects and the reference entry are fully determined and extraction continues without any assumed numeric guarantee. Non-blocking for approval.
issues.recovery_condition: The task side supplies or confirms the complete comparator definition (formula, relative-error basis, normalization, non-finite and lse-absent handling) before these thresholds are used to accept a design or an implementation run; no P1-P6 extraction step is blocked meanwhile.

issues.detail: metadata.json declares the model geometries and feature combinations authoritative per shapes.full.json, which is not part of the fixed materials. The Contract adopts shape_range.json cross_field_invariants (the seven (heads, kv_heads, head_dim) tuples, heads % kv_heads == 0, and the length/sum bounds) as the declared domain, which is the only authoritative geometry declaration provided. If the missing file declared additional geometries or feature combinations, the request_geometry domain would need re-verification; no other Contract content depends on it. Non-blocking for approval.
issues.recovery_condition: The task side supplies shapes.full.json or confirms that shape_range.json cross_field_invariants is the authoritative geometry list for this operator.

conclusions.subject: mechanisms
conclusions.text: 机制概览与固定源码逐项相符：(1) host 快路径只服务 Contract 域，_forward_slow 逐条 ValueError 且无回退；(2) _plan 以 shape 为 key、不读设备张量，tiles_ub=total_m//m_tile+batch 带 slack，设备端 map_tile 重算真实 tile 并以 ok=false 丢弃空 tile，split_range 按 chunk_round(=n_tile) 取整并受设备 chunk_floor(1280 keys，防饥饿归零) 抬升；(3) 两条主计算载体（tcgen05 TMEM S|P|O 与 warp-level mma.sync 寄存器累加）共用 GQA M-packing、SW128 atom-major smem 布局与 base-2 在线 softmax（qk_scale2、exp2、lazy rescale 阈值 16、sink_adjust 的 base-2 稳定 logaddexp、lse=m+log2(l)）；(4) 三种输出形成（直接写回 / part_o+part_ml+PDL fmha_combine / decode fused 由 atomicAdd 获胜 CTA 内核内调用同一 combine_tile）均核实到具体代码；(5) grid=(kv_head,tiles_ub,splits_ub)，tc 侧 bit1 反转（默认开）、mma.sync 侧无反转，TILE_FOLD 按声明域算得恒 fold==1（total_m<=262144 → tiles_ub<=2080/16416<65535），其合规角 (32,1,*) 不在七组几何内；(6) ext slot/graph 链只改 host 发起方式、不改设备工作，graph 默认关闭且录制前该链已直接执行过。

conclusions.subject: root_choice
conclusions.text: root 选择成立。实例 fmha_tc.cu::fmha_tc_main8ws<128,64,2,2,true,false,false,1,false,true>（DH=1、MC=false 缺省）由 fmha_tc_run d128 NT64 分支在 kmap/vmap 存在且 bit26(cs_ok)+bit29(nh1_ok) 时以 192 线程启动，NCU 用例 9 的模板实参逐字相同；默认门控（_tc_ws/_tc_csplit/_cs_partial/_ws_nh1 全 ON）使 CS-NH1 成为 d128 NT64 的唯一默认形态。角色划分核实：ctrl=tid>=128，warp4=TMA-lead（prologue/box/arm/PAGEPRE 页预取），warp5=MMA-lead（pre/vv/sfree/kv 等待+全部 tcgen05 发射，PV(s) 先于 QK(s+1) 的承载序有显式注释与代码），warp0-3 每线程一整行、NH1 行最大值 lane-local 且 NT64 走 LDRED 融合 load-reduce；P 写回奇偶双缓冲 TMEM；splits==1 时 epilogue 直接写 bf16 out 与 base-2 lse。可达见证独立复算成立：batch1/q1500/kv1500/16头4kv头/d128/causal → tiles_ub=47、base=188>=148 不切分、tiles256×kvh=96<148 不触发 DH2，故 splits==1 单 launch。选它为 root 的理由（认证构建 prefill 主机制的最简完整形态、接口=一份 FmhaParams+两个 tensormap+一次 launch）与规则相符，无需最复杂或最通用。root.yaml 未改：Source 正确指向规划并启动该实例的固定 host 入口，Version 1，Design 与自身 when 依阶段规则留待 P3。

conclusions.subject: selection
conclusions.text: 拟完整集合 4 份（<=10）逐项审定通过，plan 原样回传。(1) split_kv_prefill：同一模板实例在 splits>1 时改变输出生产者（主内核只写 part_o/part_ml）、增加 grid.z 工作轴与一次 PDL 提交（producer trigger / consumer grid-dependency-sync / combine 按 exp2(m_s-m*) 归并），符合 common「split-KV 部分结果与跨 kernel 归并需要完整方案」；用例 9 实测 (8,9,4)+(8,9,5) 与我按 _plan 的复算（want=4、combine_z=5）一致。(2) mma_sync_decode：主计算载体（mma.sync）、工作划分（NSL=NT/16 的 N 分割、d256 再分 dv 半区重复 QK）与输出形成（跨 warp smem 归并 m*/sc/l/O）三项皆异，且 total_m<=64·batch 的短 query 半域唯一覆盖；用例 5 (1,9,16)+(1,9,2)（cap2=16 约束）与用例 2 splits=37、8 warp 均复算吻合；FMHA_DEC_W8 默认关 → 128 线程/MINB1 与实例串一致。(3) tc_prefill_cpasync：非 specialized 协作（tid0 独发全部 mma、每 stage 全 CTA __syncthreads、cp.async commit-group 证明 KV 就绪、无 tensormap）无法围绕 root 的 role/mbarrier 组织说清，且是 d64 NT128 无 tensormap 子域唯一覆盖；见证复算成立（33 tiles、396 blocks>=148 不切分、window>=0 挡翻转、396>296 使 nh4_ok 假且 _tc_d64_tma 默认关 → 不编码 → 尾部 main<64,128,3>）；when 保守取 splits==1、切分形态归组合记录，接口相容（同一 FmhaParams/split_range/部分结果布局/combine_tile）已核实，组合见证 splits=9 复算一致。降级安排合规：DH2 为 root 的局部记录（每半区复制同一 CS-NH1 编排、共享 K/V 流，未新增主计算或领取/退出协议；320 线程/TMEM512/133760B/tiles256/半 tile 归并均与源码公式和用例 1/7 NCU 吻合，唯一实基线链接 root.yaml）；fused 归并、不切分直接写回、KV 搬运互换成拟局部，tile 几何、grid 映射、split 取值成拟参数，依赖未来基线的七条线索按检查规则单列且不作假链接。未展开登记诚实：NH2/NH4 被 bit29 抢先（2365 行先判）、cluster/tc2/dta/MC2/tail-split 默认关、m64 prefill 属构建失败退路——均未改称参数。两处不影响取舍的措辞待 P4 修正：main8mc 一次共享取数服务 2×128=256 行（512 行属 DH2-MC）；TLSEL 实为默认开但被 NH1/CS 抢先而不可达（非「默认关闭」），TILE_FOLD 仅存在于 tc launcher（fmha_run 无 fold，域内亦不触发）。

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: 本轮亲读并用于判断：host——solution.py 的 forward 快/慢路径、_plan 全部门控与默认值（含 targets、caps、wavefill、DH2、fuse16、floor_keys、nh4/cs/nh1/dh2_ok、want_maps、_pad2 位域）、_launch/_fast_entry/_register_slot、三个 build 函数与全部编译期 defs 的默认值；implementation——fmha_tc.cu 的 fmha_tc_run 全部分支（MC/DH2/DTA/d128/d256/d64 两几何/尾部退路/-200）、grid_pos、map_tile 副本、main8ws（模板与 static_assert、smem/mbarrier/TMEM 布局、TMA-lead 与 MMA-lead 完整循环、softmax 主体、lazy rescale、奇偶 P、epilogue 双分支）、fmha_tc_main 主体与两类 loader、tc_tma_kv/tc_page_pre、fmha_tc_smem、sink_adjust、main8/dta 登记锚点；fmha_kernel.cu 的 map_tile/split_range、fmha_main 与 m16_body（N 分割、跨 warp 归并、FUSE 计数、直接写回）、combine_tile/fmha_combine/launch_pdl、实例化列表、fmha_run/fmha_combine_only、fmha_smem、_pad2 读取位；fmha_ext.cu 全文。io/input/reference/scope/acceptance——metadata.json 的 benchmark contract 与 restore 协议、input.py 构造调用、reference.py 的 sinks 与 base-2 lse、shape_range 不变量、全部 10 个 shape_cases 与 10 份 NCU csv：逐用例由 shape 独立复算 _plan 门控到内核名/模板实参/线程数/grid/smem，全部一致（含用例 5 动态 smem 103552B、用例 1 的 133760B 复算）。未深读部分如实限定：fmha_tc2.cu 与默认关闭实验的完整函数体（登记依据为模板签名、launcher 门控与源码自述实测结论）、kernel_wiki 首页/README/roofline（不提供本次设计事实）。

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: dispatch.md 无需历史即可理解：文首一段交代草案身份与三处「仅计划」的分层；范围节把任务要求域、实现实际覆盖域与本次记录范围分别说清；机制概览先定义术语（NH1/CS/DH2/PDL 等均在首次使用处展开）再给依据；完整设计表每行自带实例串（模板实参+线程数+启动分支+可达见证），计划文件以普通文本标注、不造假链接；唯一的正式变体记录（DH2）直接定位现存 root.yaml 并声明对象名为暂拟；未展开登记与未知边界各自成节、含名称/机制/范围/取舍理由。root.yaml 的 Contract 自含性已由 P1 批准且本轮抽核未变。

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: 分层正确：目录不覆盖 YAML——表格明示「精确参数、when 与修订号以 YAML 为准」，正式 ID 与 when 留 P3/P5；root.yaml 保持 P1 批准的共享 Contract 原样（Version 1、Source 与 Golden_reference 固定到 4849028），DESIGN 仍为骨架（文件止于 152 行）属 P2 合法状态，本批准不含 root 完整 Design；机制细节（tile 几何、split 取值、grid 序）留在目录作为参数/局部记录线索，未渗入 Contract；执行单元使用未超出 P1 的 thread/warp/cta 登记，cluster 方案明示若入选须先回 P1。

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: 全文一致：plan_draft 四条 instance 与完整设计表逐字对应；两个可达见证与组合见证经独立复算与门控公式一致（47/188/96<148；33/396>296；17/34/want9/chunk881<2048）；10 个固定用例的 NCU 内核名、模板实参、线程数、grid 与由 shape_cases 经 _plan 的复算全部吻合；DH2 记录的 320 线程/TMEM512/133.7KB/tiles_ub 公式与 fmha_tc_smem、launch_bounds、NCU 动态 smem 逐项一致；两个 chunk_floor 的同名异义已显式警示。两处措辞级不一致（main8mc 的 512 行、TLSEL/TILE_FOLD 归属）不影响任何选择或记录层级，已列入 handoff 交 P4 落实目录时修正。

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: 内容必要且无过程冗余：A/B 数字仅在承载门控默认值或可达性判断处引用（如 cs_partial 反转、d64 TMA 否决、DH2 门控），属设计依据而非实验流水；退修历史、检查诊断与轮次状态只存在于回执而不在产物；未知边界节保留的是影响后续写作的真实来源限制（编码失败、计数初态、门控未穷举、NCU 环境），非可删的过程叙述；root.yaml 无 TODO、无历史批准、无重复决定。

issues.detail: 入口注释声称 causal tile 反转带来全局 LPT 序，但函数体直接取 tile=blockIdx.y；本轮独立核实 fmha_kernel.cu 全文件只读 _pad2 的 bit2(fuse)/bit3(pdl)/bit5(m16-lazy)/bit30(tail-split 跳过)，fmha_run 的 grid 亦无 fold/反转，真正的反转只在 tcgen05 侧 grid_pos 由 bit1&&causal 触发。dispatch 机制节已按函数体记录「mma.sync 内核不反转」，不影响本阶段选择。

issues.detail: 获胜者选举依赖实现自持的 int32 计数缓冲：self._cnt 仅在空/不足/换设备时由 torch.zeros 重建，FUSE 分支 __threadfence 后 tid0 atomicAdd(counters[tile*kvh+kvh])，读到 active-1 者获胜并把自己的槽复位为 0，源码无其他重初始化或代际标记；metadata.json 的 restore_before_each_call 只恢复 out/lse/workspace_buffer，不覆盖该内部缓冲。「每次调用开始时计数为零」是跨调用状态前提：若某次 launch 在 atomicAdd 与复位之间被放弃，残留计数会让后续调用选错获胜者或无人写 out。前提可确定、不阻塞选择，但不能由正文省略或默认隔离补造；dispatch 未知边界节已登记。
issues.recovery_condition: P3/P5 在 mma_sync_decode 及其 fused 局部记录中显式写出计数缓冲的零初态、获胜者复位责任与跨调用寿命；若来源不足以支撑该保证，按来源限制记录并说明对输出完成关系的影响，不补造等待或隔离。
issues.scope: mma_sync_decode 的内核内 fused 归并（fmha_kernel.cu FUSE 分支）及其计数缓冲，落到该节点未来的存储/资源与动作定义
